summary.intent: Capture implementation decisions for Phase 20 (vault migration: moving rootFolderKey from DB to IPFS vault blob v2) and create executable PLAN.md files for that phase.
summary.outcome: CONTEXT.md was created and committed on a feature branch with all key decisions locked. Research, validation strategy, and 4 plans in 3 waves were generated, but the planner-checker loop found 2 blockers and was mid-revision when the transcript ended.

repo: Vault blob v2 format: 0x02 | uint16 key_length | ECIES_key | AES_GCM_metadata — defined in ARCHITECTURE.md research doc
encryptedRootFolderKey lives in the DB vault entity as the existing crypto storage; encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey is HKDF-derivable and its stored copy is redundant
Migration strategy is dual-write (v2 blob + DB), version-aware read, triggered on next login rather than on publish
Three clients must all be updated: web (TypeScript), desktop (Rust/Tauri), and recovery tool — blob v2 logic belongs in @cipherbox/core for TypeScript and a Rust equivalent
IPNS resolution uses network-first with DB fallback (from Phase 19); Kubo is the current performance bottleneck
Phase 18 added server-side Prometheus histograms for IPNS resolve/publish; Phase 22 will add end-to-end login-to-vault timing — baseline infrastructure exists

code.finding: Contains encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey columns — both to be NULLed post-migration, eventually dropped
Vault init lives in @cipherbox/core per Phase 19.1 SDK extraction; blob v2 read/write logic should also live here
Vault type definitions — relevant for extending to support v2 blob format
Server-side vault service — API should accept but ignore IPNS key after deprecation
Web client vault store — needs update to write v2 blob on root folder publish
Desktop Rust vault commands — IPNS key HKDF-derivability already verified here; needs Rust equivalent of blob v2 logic

workflow: The gsd discuss-phase → plan-phase pipeline correctly carries prior context (Phases 19, 19.1) forward to avoid re-asking settled questions
gsd-tools.cjs commit command uses git signing via 1Password agent; subprocess contexts can't prompt 1Pass, so commits from agent subprocesses will fail if user is AFK
The plan-checker → planner revision loop (max 3 iterations) caught 2 blockers on the first pass, validating the quality gate is working

friction: Git commit failed mid-session because the 1Password signing agent wasn't available in the subprocess context (user was AFK and missed the notification)
The assistant initially attempted to commit to main instead of creating a feature branch first — required user correction
Commit retry after branch creation also hit the signing issue, requiring a second user intervention to unlock 1Password
open_items: Plan revision loop was mid-flight (iteration 1/3, 2 blockers) when transcript ended — plans need checker to pass before execution
DB column DROP migration deferred until all users have been migrated to v2 blob
IPFS-only retry-then-error mode deferred until Kubo performance improvements prove out
Client-side 'first login → fully loaded vault' baseline metrics not yet collected — Phase 22 instrumentation will cover this after the fact
